L&D Video Analytics 2026

Simpro drives — of all L&D video views this year. BigChange is the fastest-growing library, from a February start to its busiest month in October, and AroFlo's listed videos picked up from July.

Last refreshed — · refreshed monthly on the first Monday · months run 1st to last day (UTC); the latest month is to date

Objective

This dashboard shows how the training videos made or hosted by Learning & Development are used across Simpro, BigChange, AroFlo and ClockShark. It helps the L&D team decide which videos to refresh, promote, shorten or retire, and which topics to make next.

  • Track reach: monthly views, hours watched and finish rates per brand, against the month before and the year so far.
  • Judge quality: how much of each video people watch, and which videos they finish.
  • See the audience: the countries, devices and sites people watch from.
  • Follow new content: how the videos uploaded in 2026 are taking off.

For the L&D team and brand stakeholders. Figures come from Vimeo Analytics and are read once a month. This is the team edition: it opens in any browser without a Claude account and is updated at the same link each month.

Simpro Group is a one-page briefing for leadership. Each brand tab is the detailed team view for that brand, with insights and action points.

Insights and action points

What the numbers say this year, and what the team can do next month.

What's working

  • The 17 showcases (— videos) reach thousands of customers every month, mostly through the Simpro Help Guide.
  • Short videos hold attention: 3 minutes or less are watched — on average.
  • The busiest showcase, Workflows, has — views this year.

Watch-outs

  • Views have drifted down since March's peak.
  • — of views are on videos uploaded in 2017–2019, so outdated screens are likely.
  • The — showcase videos uploaded in 2026 have only — views between them.
  • Videos over 5 minutes are watched — on average, and "Simpro Mobile – Assets" (6 min) only about a third of the way.

Action points

  1. Audit the 20 most-watched 2017–2019 videos for outdated screens, starting with Workflows and Set up Simpro Premium.
  2. Split "Simpro Mobile – Assets" and the other long, low-completion videos in the table below into short chapters.
  3. Promote the 2026 videos (AI Scheduler, Deposits, Job Focus View) in release notes and the matching Help Guide pages.
  4. When a release changes a screen, update the matching top-viewed video before making new content.

What's working

  • Fastest growth of any brand: — views in October against — in February.
  • The — short GIF clips bring — views, and the play rate is the best of the four brands (—).
  • Most views come from BigChange University articles, so embedding clips in articles works.

Watch-outs

  • Each viewer plays about — clips: looping clips count repeat plays, so views overstate reach. Track viewers and finish rate.
  • "Using the BigChange App" (11 min) is watched only about 15% of the way.
  • "GIF – Log into the app" is watched — on average.

Action points

  1. Keep the short-clip format for new BCU articles.
  2. Split "Using the BigChange App" into short task-based clips.
  3. Re-cut the low-completion clips in the table below so the key step comes in the first seconds.
  4. Report BigChange on viewers and finish rate, not raw views.

What's working

  • Views rose from about — a month (January to June) to — (July to October); the first half includes a one-off April spike.
  • The — listed videos uploaded in 2026 bring — of views, led by Apple CarPlay and the AI-agent videos.

Watch-outs

  • — of the — listed videos had fewer than 5 views this year.
  • In the last full month viewers watched — of the average video, against — for the year.
  • "Connecting to AroFlo Payments" is watched under 20% of the way.

Action points

  1. Review the low-view videos with the AroFlo team: retire, merge or re-promote each one.
  2. Embed the videos in help.aroflo.com articles instead of sharing vimeo.com links.
  3. Tighten the opening of "Connecting to AroFlo Payments" and "Setting Print and Email Defaults".
  4. Feature the AI-agent videos (JobScribe, JobReady, FieldReady) where customers set those agents up.

What's working

  • Spanish versions bring — of ClockShark Mobile views.
  • Nearly all views come from the ClockShark help site.

Watch-outs

  • The 24-minute QuickBooks Desktop series is watched — on average.
  • ClockShark Mobile's play rate looks very low because of one April spike: — of — impressions. Outside April it is —.

Action points

  2. Rebuild the most-watched legacy topics (time tracking, timesheet approval) in the current L&D style.

    SourceViewsShare
    How these numbers are gathered and what's left out
    • Read from Vimeo Analytics across the AroFlo, BigChange and Simpro Learning workspaces and refreshed monthly (first Monday) by a scheduled Claude task. Figures are kept by calendar month (UTC days), so time frames are whole months; the latest month runs to the last refresh. "Change" compares the chosen months with the same number of months just before them.
    • Simpro: the de-duplicated set of videos in the 17 showcases of the Simpro Learning workspace (— videos). Videos outside those showcases, such as "Lightning Features", are left out.
    • AroFlo: exactly the 97 video IDs in the "AroFlo L&D + Requested Image Videos V3 (With Links)" sheet, wherever they sit. Not found in Vimeo: —.
    • BigChange: the New BCU 2026 folder. ClockShark: the ClockShark Mobile folder (made by L&D) and the ClockShark (Old Wistia vids) folder (hosted by L&D).
    • Avg % watched is weighted by views. Unique viewers are not shown for time frames because they can't be added across months. Sources beyond the top 50 per month count as Other.
